meta.name: beachhead-segment
meta.description: Identify the first beachhead market segment for a product launch. Evaluates segments against burning pain, willingness to pay, winnable market share, and referral potential. Use when choosing a first market, targeting an initial customer segment, or planning market entry strategy.

copy.tagline: 找出产品上市的首个滩头市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正为新产品寻找第一个目标市场。
copy.tagline_en: Identify the first beachhead market for your product launch
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are choosing the first target market for a new product.

howto.what: 分析你提供的产品信息和市场数据，从多个候选细分市场中，根据痛点、付费意愿、可赢取份额和推荐潜力四个维度评分，推荐最适合作为首个切入点的细分市场，并给出获客计划和扩张路线。
howto.when: 当你需要为新产品选择第一个目标市场、确定首批客户群体，或制定市场进入策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下这款企业培训软件的首个目标市场。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供产品描述和市场数据，然后输出推荐。

say.text: 我有三个潜在客户群体，请评估哪个最适合作为滩头阵地。
say.note: Claude 会逐一评分并给出最佳选择。

howto.what_en: Analyzes your product info and market data, scores candidate segments on burning pain, willingness to pay, winnable share, and referral potential, then recommends the best beachhead segment with a customer acquisition plan and expansion roadmap.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to choose a first market for a new product, target an initial customer segment, or plan market entry strategy.

say_en.text: Analyze the first target market for this enterprise training software.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for product description and data, then output a recommendation.

say_en.text: I have three potential customer groups. Evaluate which is best as a beachhead.
say_en.note: Claude will score each and recommend the best one.
